purpose: Static citation-table lookup of UNCITRAL MLETR (Model Law on Electronic Transferable Records) adoption status per jurisdiction -- statute, scope, and effective date, data_version stamped -- and a corridor verdict for whether an electronic bill of lading (eBL) is legally effective end-to-end between an origin and destination jurisdiction (UK, Singapore, UAE, Bahrain, France, Japan, India, US, Germany at this data_version). Answers the 'is an eBL legally effective in corridor X->Y' practitioner question that sits upstream of the MLETR control-evidence chain (art-352/art-353).
